high_level_description: The image depicts a person posing in a studio setting. They also wear red fingerless gloves. The person has long, wavy blonde hair and is striking a pose with one arm raised above their head and the other resting on a surface. The background is a plain, light gray color, which helps to highlight the subject. There is a shadow cast by the person onto the wall behind them, adding depth to the image.
